summary: A search box and its button, in a search landmark.
use: Site search, or the search box on a results page, which shows the query as its value.

action.description: The results page; without it, the search submits to the page it's on.

label.description: Names the box, such as "Search the shop".

name.description: The field's name in the submitted form data.

value.description: The query, on a results page. One line.
